features.fullDescription: L-plan 2-storey coursed red granite, part pinned; kiln stone-built; good vent with sawwheel vane. Wheel internal and below ground level. Single-storey and loft outbuilding, red granite with grey dressings. ? early 19th cent. Disused but in good order.
